posts.title: Android 17 把 Gemini 放進日常操作，Google 想先搶下手機端 AI 入口
posts.seoTitle: Android 17 與 Gemini 新功能：Google 搶手機端 AI 入口
posts.seoDescription: TechCrunch 報導 Android 17、Wear OS 7 與 Pixel Drop 更新。重點不只新功能，而是 Google 正把 Gemini 放進分享、影片、音樂與安全場景。
posts.excerpt: TechCrunch 6 月 16 日報導，Google 發布 Android 17、Wear OS 7 與 Pixel Drop，新增多工泡泡列、Gemini 影片編輯、Lyria 3 音樂生成、即時翻譯與手錶安全偵測。這次更新把 AI 從獨立功能推進手機與穿戴裝置的高頻操作。
posts.topic: Android 17 launches with new multitasking tools as Google expands Gemini features
posts.geoSummary: TechCrunch 6 月 16 日報導，Google 透過 Android 17、Wear OS 7 與 Pixel Drop，把 Gemini 影片編輯、Lyria 3 音樂生成、翻譯與安全偵測推進手機和手錶。產品團隊可用這則消息觀察 AI 入口如何從 app 轉向系統層操作。
posts.body:
TechCrunch 6 月 16 日報導，Google 發布 Android 17、Wear OS 7 與 Pixel Drop，新增多工泡泡列、Gemini Omni 對話式影片編輯、Lyria 3 文字或圖片生成音樂、Pixel 10a 語音翻譯，以及 Pixel Watch 的車禍、跌倒與脈搏異常偵測。

這批更新把 Gemini 放進使用者每天會碰到的分享、創作、翻譯、安全和多工場景。Quick Share 支援與 AirDrop 相容，讓舊款 Pixel 8a 與 9a 使用者更容易跨裝置傳檔；影片與音樂生成則把 Gemini 往手機端創作工具推近一步；Wear OS 7 的緊急偵測則讓 AI 與感測器能力更靠近日常安全。

對 Google 來說，Android 17 的重點在於搶下系統層入口。當 AI 能力直接出現在通知、分享、影片、語音與手錶安全流程裡，使用者不一定需要主動打開某個 AI app。這會改變 app 團隊與企業 IT 的判斷：未來要看的不只是模型能力，也包括預設流程、資料權限、裝置管理和人工接管邊界。

接下來要觀察三件事：第一，Gemini 功能會停留在 Pixel 還是擴到更多 Android 裝置；第二，手機端 AI 會如何影響 app 的使用入口；第三，企業裝置管理政策能否跟上系統層 AI 功能擴散。
keyTakeaways: TechCrunch 6 月 16 日報導，Android 17、Wear OS 7 與 Pixel Drop 把 Gemini、翻譯、多工與安全功能推進裝置層。
Google 正把 AI 放進分享、創作、語音、手錶安全等高頻場景，降低使用者主動打開 AI app 的門檻。
企業導入 Android 裝置時，需要同步看 AI 功能、資料權限、裝置管理與人工接管邊界。

TechCrunch AI reports Android 17 launches with new multitasking tools as Google expands Gemini features. Google has released Android 17 and Wear OS 7, introducing new multitasking features, parental controls, security tools, and smartwatch upgrades. TechCrunch AI reports Android 17 launches with new multitasking tools as Google expands Gemini features.

The latest feature release underscores Google’s strategy of using its Android and Pixel devices to its latest AI technology. While its rival Apple is focused on catching up in AI with September’s public launch of AI upgrades to Siri and iOS 27, Google’s Android 17 is focused on its newest AI models, Gemini’s role in creation, communication, and other device experiences.

In today’s Pixel Drop, Android Quick Share’s file-sharing feature will become compatible with Apple’s AirDrop on older Pixel 8a and 9a devices. Plus, Gemini Omni will now let you edit videos in a conversation, while Lyria 3 lets users create music tracks with text prompts and/or images in the Gemini app. Pixel 10a devices will also get better speech-to-speech translation tools with AudioLM.

Other phone features are arriving, too, such as the ability to record a personalized outgoing audio message for callers when you can’t answer. Plus, the “Take a Message” feature will arrive in more global markets.

The Pixel Drop brings emergency detection features to the Google Pixel Watch as well, meaning that if the watch detects a car crash, fall, or lack of pulse, it will automatically contact emergency services and your selected emergency contacts.

Beyond AI, Android 17’s larger update allows users to take advantage of features like a “bubble bar,” which is a new user interface element that lets you organize, move, and then quickly access recent apps that appear as bubbles at the bottom of your screen.
